author: More Perfect Union
description:
The owner of a Texas warehouse says they won't sell or lease to DHS after the community raised concerns about ICE. So we went down to Hutchins, Texas. to learn about how communities are stopping warehouses from falling into ICE's hands.

Producer: Mae Ryan
Editor: @discosludge
Videographer: Andrew Jernigan
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: SMALL TOWN STANDS UP: Texans kill massive ICE detention center
